blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Real-world enterprise data science and analytics workflows require reasoning across dozens of tables, performing statistical analyses, and acting on the results. Established text-to-SQL benchmarks evaluate query generation alone, and audits have found their answer keys frequently wrong. Because real enterprise warehouses are too sensitive to release, these benchmarks are built on public datasets where a business event fits in a single table. We introduce Argo-Bench, an evaluation framework comprising 210 data science and analytics tasks. Drawing on public data, peer-reviewed industry literature, and regulatory filings, we simulate a food delivery platform in New York City at true scale, with 81 million orders in 2024, grounded economics, fraud patterns, and marketplace incentives. We export this world to an ERP warehouse of 235 tables and 7.5 billion rows, modeled on the Oracle E-Business Suite schema. The simulator’s ground-truth state is withheld from the warehouse the agent sees, so tasks require reconstructing facts by navigating the warehouse before acting on them. Argo-Bench goes beyond text-to-SQL: the agent files actions such as banning fraudulent accounts, allocating courier incentive budgets, or issuing back pay, and the grader scores each by its consequences in the simulator. Every task has an executable reference solution that demonstrates solvability using only the warehouse. The strongest of 14 frontier and open-weight models scores 95 or higher on only 34.8% of tasks and averages 59.5 points. We hope Argo-Bench drives progress toward agents that understand, navigate, and act within real data environments.
blocks.zh: 现实世界企业数据科学和分析工作流程需要数十个表格进行推理,进行统计分析,并根据结果采取行动。 既定的文本对SQL基准仅评价查询生成,审计发现其答案密钥经常出错. 由于真正的企业仓库太敏感,无法放行,这些基准建立在公共数据集上,其中商务活动适合在一个表格中。 我们介绍了Argo-Bench,这是一个包括210个数据科学和分析任务的评价框架。 利用公共数据、同行评审的行业文献和监管备案,我们模拟了纽约市真正规模的食品交付平台,2024年订购了8100万份订单,基础经济学、欺诈模式和市场激励。 我们把这个世界出口到一个235个桌子和75亿行的ERP仓库, 以Oracle E-Business suite schema为模型。 模拟器的地表真实状态从代理商看到的仓库中被扣住,因此任务需要先通过浏览仓库再重建事实,然后再对仓库采取行动. Argo-Bench超越了文本到SQL:代理者将禁用欺诈账户,分配信使奖励预算,或发回还款等动作归档,分级员按其后果在模拟器中逐一评分. 每个任务都有一个可执行的参考解决方案,只使用仓库来证明可溶解性. 14个前沿和开放量级模型中最强的只有34.8%的任务得分95分或更高,平均得分59.5分. 我们希望Argo-Bench推动在真正数据环境下 理解、导航和行动的代理商的进步。

blocks.en: In recent years, data agents have advanced from answering simple text-to-SQL questions over small, well-documented schemas to performing long-horizon data science tasks, publishing durable company-wide assets such as dashboards, and acting on their findings, for instance, by adjusting promotions and banning fraudulent accounts ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . Rising scores on established data benchmarks could be read as a sign that enterprise data work is close to solved. The best Spider 2.0-Snow score has risen from 23.8% at release ( Lei et al., 2025 ) to 96.7%, and the top BIRD entry reaches 82.4% against a human 93.0%. 1 1 1 Spider 2.0 leaderboard: https://spider2-sql.github.io/ ; BIRD leaderboard: https://bird-bench.github.io/ ; both accessed September 24, 2026.
blocks.zh: 近年来,数据代理从回答简单文本对SQL问题到完成长距离数据科学任务,如发布仪表板等全公司耐用资产,以及根据调查结果采取行动,例如调整晋升和禁止欺诈账户(Sun等,2025;Liu等,2026;Li等,2026)。 既定数据基准的分数上升可被理解为企业数据工作接近解决的标志。 最佳"蜘蛛2.0-雪"得分从发布时的23.8%(Lei等,2025年)上升到96.7%,BIRD最高入分达到82.4%,对阵人类93.0%. 11 1 Spider 2.0领跑板:https://spider2-sql.github.io/;BIRD领跑板:https://bird-bench.github.io/;两者均于2026年9月24日查阅.

blocks.en: However, current benchmarks primarily evaluate text-to-SQL performance and are not representative of enterprise agentic data workflows in three important ways. First, they run on a patchwork of public data. Spider 2.0-Snow’s 547 questions sparsely cover a sprawling collection of 152 databases (Appendix H ). Over a third of those databases are used for a single question only. Two thirds of the questions use BigQuery public datasets; another quarter use local sample databases ( Lei et al., 2025 ) . These public and local sources’ schemas are documented in tutorials and textbooks. Furthermore, there is a high degree of overlap among tables: at least two thirds of the tables are date-, geography-, or version-sharded copies of another table. In an enterprise warehouse, different modules must agree on the same numbers, and one business event may touch ten or more tables ( Plattner, 2014 ) .
blocks.zh: 然而,目前的基准主要评价文本对SQL的性能,在三个重要方面并不代表企业代理数据工作流程. 首先,他们运行 拼凑的公共数据。 Spider 2.0-Snow的547个问题, 其中三分之一以上的数据库只用于一个问题。 三分之二的问题使用BigQuery公共数据集;而另一季度则使用当地样本数据库(Lei等人,2025年)。 这些公共和地方来源的图谋在辅导和教科书中都有记载。 此外,各表之间高度重叠:至少三分之二的表是另一表的日期、地理或版本硬拷贝。 在企业仓库中,不同的模块必须商定相同的数字,一个商务事件可能触及到10个或更多的表格(Plattner,2014.).

blocks.en: Second, they are not end-to-end. Many of the most valuable enterprise data science tasks cannot be done in SQL. Fitting a demand forecast, training a fraud model, or optimizing a courier schedule requires statistical, machine learning, and optimization libraries. Additionally, findings lead to decisions, which are ultimately judged by their return on investment. For instance, a promotion with a high redemption rate can still lose money if most of those orders would have been placed anyway ( Xu et al., 2025b ) . A gold answer cannot distinguish between such decisions.
blocks.zh: 第二,它们不是端到端。 许多最有价值的企业数据科学任务无法在SQL中完成. 满足需求预测、培训欺诈模式或优化信使时间表需要统计、机器学习和优化图书馆。 此外,调查结果导致决定,最终根据投资回报来判断。 例如,如果这些订单大多数都已经发出,那么高赎回率的晋升仍然可能失去金钱(徐等,2025年b)。 黄金答案无法区分这种决定。

blocks.en: Third, they are not verifiable. On real data, a benchmark can only measure agreement with its annotators since writing the answer key requires solving the task. Even when the answer is in the data, annotators may miss it. In a recent audit, 62.8% of Spider 2.0-Snow’s released gold queries and 52.8% of BIRD Mini-Dev’s were found to be erroneous, most often because annotators misread the data or the schema, and correcting BIRD’s errors moved agents’ leaderboard standings by up to nine places ( Jin et al., 2026 ) . Furthermore, for many of the most valuable enterprise tasks, the answer may not be in the data at all. Fraud left undetected leaves no label ( Altman et al., 2023 ) , and the outcomes of a rejected decision are never observed.
blocks.zh: 第三,它们不能核查。 在真实数据上,一个基准只能衡量与它的注释者达成的协议,因为写出答案键需要解决任务. 即使答案在数据中,注释者也可能错过. 在最近的一项审计中,发现62.8%的Spider 2.0-Snow发布的金质查询和52.8%的BIRD Mini-Dev都是错误的,最经常的原因是注释者误读了数据或计划,并且纠正了BIRD的错误使代理商的领导板站了多达9个位置(Jin等,2026年). 此外,对于许多最有价值的企业任务,答案可能根本不在数据中。 欺诈行为未被发现,没有留下标签(Altman等人,2023年),驳回决定的结果从未被遵守。

blocks.en: Large enterprises keep the records that financial planning, forecasting, and fraud detection require in enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems ( Davenport, 1998 ) such as Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), SAP S/4HANA, and Oracle Fusion Cloud, extended with custom tables representing idiosyncrasies and workflows unique to the business ( Brehm et al., 2001 ) . Because the same systems hold the company’s ledgers, payroll, and customer records, access to them is heavily restricted. For this reason, ERP data has remained practically unexplored in benchmarks to date. When such data is released, it must be anonymized, which can break the relational structure that answers depend on. In an early release of BEAVER ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , the closest attempt to date, Chung et al. (2025) report primary keys that violate their uniqueness constraints and questions whose gold query is null.
blocks.zh: 大型企业在企业资源规划系统(Davenport, 1998年)中保存财务规划、预测和欺诈侦查所需的记录,例如Oracle E-Business Suite(EBS),SAP S/4HANA,和Oracle Fusion Cloud, 并附有代表企业独有的特性和工作流程的自定义表(Brehm等人,2001年)。 由于同一系统持有公司的分类账、工资单和客户记录,因此访问这些系统受到严重限制。 因此,迄今为止,在基准中几乎没有对企业资源规划系统数据进行探讨。 当这类数据被发布时,它必须是匿名的,这可以打破答案所依赖的关系结构. BEAVER(Chen等,2024年)的早期出道中,是迄今为止最接近的尝试. Chung等. (2025)报告违反其独有性限制的主键和黄金查询无效的问题.

blocks.en:
We instead simulate a business and grade against the simulation’s ground truth (Figure 1 ). Argo-Bench models a food delivery platform in New York City in 2024, a three-sided marketplace whose economics are disclosed to the city every month ( 49 ) . The simulator reflects a real minimum-pay increase in April 2024 ( 50 ) , and is calibrated to these disclosures and to public filings. None of its data is generated by a language model. We project this world into an Oracle EBS warehouse that omits the simulator’s latent state, so tasks are harder to solve than to verify ( Song et al., 2025 ) . The agent must reconstruct facts from the warehouse, while the grader reads them off the state. Agents work in a sandboxed Python environment with statistics, machine-learning, and optimization libraries (Appendix F ), and file their decisions and results through a mission-control interface rather than returning a query.
Because the grader knows the latent state, it can grade a decision by its consequences. For instance, a list of banned accounts is scored by the fraud losses it prevents, including losses from fraud that the platform never detected, net of the revenue lost from wrongly banned customers.
blocks.zh:
相反,我们用模拟的地面真相来模拟企业和等级(图1)。 Argo-Bench在2024年对纽约市的食品运送平台进行模式化设计, 模拟器反映了2024年(50年)4月的实际最低工资增长,并对这些披露和公开备案进行调整。 其数据无一由语言模型生成. 我们把这个世界投放到一个Oracle EBS仓库中, 特工必须从仓库重建事实,而分级员则读取了州外的事实. 代理人在一个沙盒式的Python环境中工作,有统计、机器学习和优化库(Appendix F),并通过任务控制接口而不是返回查询来存档其决定和结果。
因为分级者知道潜在的状态,所以可以根据其后果分级一个决定. 例如,一个被禁账户清单被它所防止的欺诈损失打分,包括平台从未发现的欺诈损失,减去错误被禁客户的收入损失。

blocks.en: Simulated environments are an established practice in a broad range of domains ( Altman et al., 2023 ; Lopez-Rojas et al., 2016 ; Trivedi et al., 2024 ; Barres et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2026 ) , and synthetic warehouses have long been used to benchmark data systems ( Nambiar & Poess, 2006 ; Ghazal et al., 2013 ) . Even Spider 2.0 draws a fifth of its questions from synthetic, obfuscated, or textbook sample schemas (Appendix H ). To our knowledge, no prior simulated benchmark combines an enterprise-scale warehouse whose tables must agree with one another and a grader that scores the consequences of the agent’s actions against the simulator’s latent state.
blocks.zh: 模拟环境是一系列广泛领域的既定做法(Altman等,2023;Lopez-Rojas等,2016;Trivedi等,2024;Barres等,2025;Xu等,2025a; Huang等,2026),和合成仓库被长期用于基准数据系统(Nambiar & Poess,2006;Ghazal等,2013.). 甚至"蜘蛛2.0"也从"合成","被蒙蔽"或"教科书样本计划"(Appendix H. 据我们所知,没有一个预先模拟的基准将一个必须相互同意的企业规模仓库和一个分级员结合起来,根据模拟员的潜伏状态对代理人行为的后果进行评分。

blocks.en: We evaluate 14 frontier and open-weight models on Argo-Bench. The strongest, Claude Opus 5.5, solves 34.8% of tasks and averages 59.5 points. Nine of the fourteen average below 35. Models often analyze the wrong quantity or optimize the wrong objective.
blocks.zh: 我们在阿尔戈-本奇上评估了14个前沿和开放式模型。 最强者克洛德·奥普斯(Claude Opus 5.5)解决了34.8%的任务,平均得分59.5分. 35岁以下14个平均数中有9个。 模型经常分析出错误的数量或优化错误的目标.

blocks.en: We make the following contributions: • A synthetic, large-scale public ERP dataset in Oracle EBS format for a 2024 New York City food delivery platform, comprising 235 mutually constraining tables, 81 million orders, 3.4 million active customers, and 7.5 billion rows, in which an order resolves into dispatch decisions, courier pay, merchant payouts, and balanced general-ledger journals. • A grader that scores the consequences of an action rather than the correctness of a query, using the simulator’s latent state as ground truth, for instance, to score bans by the fraud losses they prevent and forecasts against held-out months, supporting tasks across fraud detection, forecasting, and financial planning. • A benchmark of 210 such tasks, from publishing a dashboard data source to fitting forecasts and banning fraudulent accounts, with an evaluation of 14 frontier and open-weight models.
blocks.zh: 我们作出以下贡献: 以Oracle EBS格式为2024年纽约市食品交付平台提供合成的大规模公共ERP数据集,包括235个相互制约的表格,8100万订单,340万活跃客户,以及75亿行,其中一项命令决定了调度决定,信使支付,商家支付,以及平衡的通用引导日记. 二. 支助 以模拟器的潜在状态为底线的真相,对某一行为的后果进行评分,而不是对查询的正确性进行评分,例如,通过它们所防止的欺诈损失和对被搁置月份的预测来评分禁令,支持各项任务,包括发现欺诈、预测和财务规划。 • 以210个这类任务为基准,从公布仪表板数据源到安装预报和禁止欺诈性账户,并对14个前沿和开放式模型进行评价。

blocks.en: 2 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 2 基准建设

blocks.en: 2.1 World Simulation
blocks.zh: 2.1 世界模拟

blocks.en: We simulate a food delivery platform in New York City (NYC) in 2024, similar to DoorDash, Grubhub, or Uber Eats. Public data on such platforms is aggregate. The city’s quarterly reports and the platforms’ own filings give totals, but order-level records cannot be released without exposing the platform’s customers, couriers, and margins. The world is therefore built from 34 public datasets and reports, each lending one mechanism (Appendix A ). Uber and Lyft trips, for instance, give the time to drive between two zones at a given hour, and MenuStat the menus for restaurant chains. Donors play one of three roles. Identity donors are public records of real entities in the city, such as its 45,834 restaurants, 1.07 million addresses, and 260 taxi zones, and enter the world as they are, except that the released warehouse renames some restaurants (see the ethics statement). Shape donors are measured elsewhere, on other people, in another city, or in another year, and lend the world only a distribution. Anchors are published totals that the world is calibrated to reproduce but never samples records from.
blocks.zh: 我们在2024年模拟纽约市(NYC)的一款食品提供平台,类似于"多尔达什"(DoorDash),"格鲁布"(Grubhub)或"Uber Eats". 这些平台的公共数据是汇总的。 城市的季度报告和平台本身的备案提供了总数,但订单级记录如果不暴露平台的客户、信使和利润,就无法发布。 因此,世界建立在34个公共数据集和报告之上,每个数据和报告都出借一个机制(附录A)。 例如,Uber和Lyft旅行给在两个区之间开车的时间,MenuStat则给餐厅连锁店的菜单。 捐助者发挥三种作用之一。 身份捐献者是该市实际实体的公开记录,如其45,834家餐厅,107万个住址,260个出租车区,并按原样进入世界,只是被放行的仓库将一些餐馆改名(参见道德声明). 在其他地方、在其他人、在另一个城市、或在另一年里,对形形色色的捐赠者进行衡量,只向世界发放。 锁定器是公布的总称,世界被校正以复制,但从未有样本记录来自.

blocks.en: We chose food delivery in NYC because its economics are unusually well documented. Delivery apps must report their monthly orders, consumer spending, merchant fees, courier earnings, productivity, and hours worked to the NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP), which publishes them quarterly ( 49 ) , and the 10-K filings of DoorDash and Grubhub give the shape of a platform’s balance sheet ( DoorDash, Inc., 2024b ; DoorDash, Inc., 2025 ; Grubhub Inc., 2021 ) . Following Walonoski et al. (2018) , we calibrate the world to these anchors, sized as a dominant platform. The result has 81 million orders, about 55% of the 148 million deliveries that apps reported to the DCWP for 2024, and 3.4 million active customers, and it must balance incentives on three sides: quests and suggested pay for couriers, promotions and surge pricing for customers, and co-funded campaigns for merchants. Its per-delivery economics stay within 5% of the DCWP’s figures in 13 of 16 quarterly comparisons (Figure 2 a).
blocks.zh: 我们选择在纽约市提供食物,因为其经济学有非常多的记录。 交付应用软件必须向纽约市消费者和工人保护部(DCWP)报告其每月订单、消费者开支、商费、信使收入、生产率和工作时间,该局每季度公布一次(49个),DoorDash和Grubhub的10K档案提供了平台资产负债表的形状(DoorDash, Inc.,2024b;DoorDash, Inc.,2025;Grubhub, Inc.,2021)。 结果有8100万个订单,在向DCWP报告2024年的1.48亿个应用的快递中大约占55%,还有340万活跃客户,它必须平衡三方面的激励:征途和建议支付信使,客户的晋级和快速定价,以及共同资助的商家活动. 在16个季度比较(图2a)中的13个季度中,其每季交付经济学都保持在DCWP数字的5%以内。

blocks.en: We selected 2024 because it contains a real extrinsic shock to these economics. NYC began enforcing a minimum pay rate of $17.96 per hour before tips for app-based restaurant delivery workers in December 2023 and raised it to $19.56 on April 1, 2024 ( 50 ) . We model the platforms’ response with a new courier scheduler that activates on that date, after which courier pay runs 6–9% above the anchor (Figure 2 a). The levers our platform uses may differ from those of the real platforms, but the aggregate effect is the same in direction and, to within 9%, in size, and because the world absorbs the same shock, we can ask realistic forecasting questions about it (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 我们选择了2024年,因为它包含 一个真正的外部冲击 这些经济学。 2023年12月,纽约市开始实行每小时17.96美元的最低工资标准,然后向基于应用的餐厅送货员提供小费,并于2024年4月1日(50. 我们用新的信使调度器模拟平台的反应,该调度器于该日启动,然后信使的付款比主播高出6-9%(图2a)。 我们的平台使用的杠杆可能与真实平台的杠杆不同,但总效应在方向上是一样的,在9%以内,在规模上是一样的,而且由于世界吸收了同样的冲击,我们可以提出现实的预测问题(附录B).

blocks.en: Additionally, we insert fraud patterns that public evidence shows are major problems for delivery platforms. Couriers steal orders after pickup ( Al Jazeera, 2025 ) , spoof their GPS ( Incognia, 2022 ) , grab offers with bots ( Chapman & Mehrotra, 2020 ) , or rent out their accounts ( DoorDash, Inc., 2024a ) . On the customer side, rings of new accounts farm promotions ( DoorDash, Inc., 2025 ; Incognia, 2025 ) , and stolen cards fund account takeovers and bust-outs ( DoorDash, Inc., 2025 ; Whittaker, 2018 ) . Storefronts may be shells ( Heier, 2023 ) or collude with couriers or regular customers on refunds ( DoorDash, Inc., 2023 ) , and their payouts can be diverted to changed bank accounts ( Maycock, 2024 ) . Each pattern is calibrated both to how separable real card fraud is and to how often honest customers share a device, an address, or a card, since the latter sets a detector’s precision (Appendix A ). The simulator generates the world from the donors, calibrates it to the anchors, inserts the fraud, and projects the result to the EBS format (Section 2.2 ).
blocks.zh: 此外,我们插入了欺诈模式,而公共证据表明,欺诈模式是交付平台的主要问题。 库里尔人偷取皮卡后的命令(半岛电视台,2025年),偷取他们的GPS(Incognia,2022年),用bots(Chapman & Mehrotra,2020年)抢取出价,或租出他们的账户(DoorDash, Inc.,2024a.). 客户方面,新账农场促销环(DoorDash, Inc., 2025; Incogina, 2025;),和被窃取的卡片基金账户收购和倒闭(DoorDash, Inc., 2025; Whittaker, 2018. 存储面额可能是贝壳(Heier,2023年)或与信使或普通客户串通退款(DoorDash, Inc., 2023年),其付款可转入已变更的银行账户(Maycock, 2024年). 每个图案都被校正为真实的卡片欺诈如何分离,以及诚实的客户经常共享一个设备,一个地址,或者一个卡片,因为后者设置了检测器的精度(附录A. 模拟器从捐赠者那里生成出世界,将其校正为主播,插入欺诈,并将结果投放到EBS格式(第2.2节).

blocks.en: 2.2 Warehouse Design and Validation
blocks.zh: 2.2 仓库设计和鉴定

blocks.en: The simulator’s last step projects the world into what an analyst actually sees: the analytics export of a greenfield Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) 12.2 instance. We chose EBS because its data model is publicly documented, so our schema can be verified against a reference. We designed the schema with three ERP consultants who have 14 to 31 years of experience.
blocks.zh: 模拟器的最后一步将世界描绘成一个分析师实际看到的:一个绿地甲骨文E-Business Suite(EBS)12.2例的分析输出。 我们选择EBS是因为它的数据模型是公开记录的,所以我们的计划可以参照一个参考材料来验证. 我们设计了这个计划,有三名企业资源规划顾问,他们有14至31年的经验。

blocks.en: Every standard table and column in our warehouse exists in the data dictionary of Oracle’s EBS 12.2 Vision instance, the demo environment Oracle provides as a reference. Our tables, however, carry on average 52% of the columns of their Vision counterparts. EBS serves every industry, and analytics exports omit the columns a business does not use, here unused flexfields (a third of the omitted columns) and features such as shipping, inventory, foreign currency, and withholding tax. These columns would be empty in this business’s data, so no task loses information by their omission.
blocks.zh: 我们仓库里的每一个标准表格和栏目都存在于Oracle的EBS 12.2 Vision实例的数据词典中,演示环境Oracle作为参考. 然而,我们的表格平均载有《愿景》对应部分52%的栏目。 EBS服务于每一个行业,分析出口省略了企业不使用的栏目,这里没有使用的弹性场(省略栏的三分之一)以及航运、库存、外币和预扣税等特征。 这些列在本行的数据中是空的,所以任何任务都不会因为遗漏而丢失信息.

blocks.en: The warehouse does not contain data drift or inconsistencies, such as deprecated tables that overlap active ones or figures that fail to reconcile across tables. These inconsistencies sometimes accumulate in real data warehouses over years of migrations and acquisitions ( Vogelsgesang et al., 2018 ) . Though the consultants named this the most significant difference from their customers’ systems, we deliberately chose to keep this discrepancy. By doing so, we keep the ground truth unambiguous: if a legacy table were to disagree with an active one, the correct answer would depend on undocumented conventions. Mature warehouses compensate for their idiosyncrasies with semantic layers, data models, and institutional knowledge ( Kandel et al., 2012 ) . While we could provide such a layer alongside a more realistic messy warehouse, this would shift the evaluation’s focus to testing an ability to use a curated layer. We instead aim to test an understanding of enterprise data organization: production workloads reuse only a few dozen combinations of hundreds of tables ( van Renen et al., 2024 ) , and an agent new to a warehouse must discover which ones matter by deciding what and how much of the warehouse to explore. A greenfield warehouse isolates this skill of understanding and exploring enterprise data organization.
blocks.zh: 仓库内没有数据漂移或不一致之处,例如与有效表格相重叠的折旧表或无法核对各表的数字。 这些不一致之处有时会随着多年的迁移和收购而累积在真实的数据仓库中(Vogelsgesang等,2018年). 虽然顾问们将这一点称为与客户系统最大的区别,但我们还是故意选择保持这一差异。 通过这样做,我们毫不含糊地说明事实真相:如果一个遗留问题表不同意一个活跃的问题,正确的答案将取决于没有记录的公约。 成熟的仓库用语义分层、数据模型和机构知识来补偿其特点(Kandel等,2012年)。 虽然我们可以在更现实的杂乱仓库旁边提供这样一个层,但这会把评价的重点转移到测试使用一层层的能力上。 相反,我们的目标是测试对企业数据组织的理解:生产工作量只重复使用几十个组合的上百个表格(van Reenen等人,2024年),而仓库的新代理人必须通过决定仓库的多少和多少来发现哪些重要。 绿地仓库孤立出这种理解和探索企业数据组织的技能.

blocks.en: Otherwise, the consultants found the schema realistic, with two further omissions. It records no foreign-currency transactions, since no donor dataset covers the currencies visitors pay in, and it has only 43 balance sheet accounts (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh: 否则,顾问们认为这一计划是现实的,还有两个遗漏。 它没有记录任何外币交易,因为没有捐助者的数据集涵盖游客支付的货币,它只有43个资产负债表账户(第5节)。

blocks.en: 2.3 Task Design
blocks.zh: 2.3 任务设计

blocks.en: Argo-Bench contains 210 tasks in five business areas (Figure 3 a). Trust and safety tasks are enforcement, where the agent finds fraud and abuse and acts on the accounts involved. FP&A tasks forecast unit economics and rebuild finance dashboards, marketplace tasks forecast courier supply and allocate budgets such as courier bonuses, accounting tasks report final values after the fact, and growth tasks measure, forecast, and publish the results of promotions and memberships.
blocks.zh: Argo-Bench包含5个商业领域的210个任务(图3 a). 信任和安全任务是强制执行,即代理人发现欺诈和滥用行为并在所涉账户上采取行动。 FP&A任务预测单位经济并重建财务仪表板,市场任务预测信使供应并分配预算,如信使奖金,会计任务报告事后的最终值,增长任务测量,预测,并公布晋升和会员的结果.

blocks.en: Each task has four parts (Appendix G ). The prompt states the problem as a stakeholder would. The scope sets the last month of 2024 visible to the agent. The expectations list the filings the grader requires, each with its action, keys, and grading mode. The answer key is frozen before any run and comes from SQL over the latent tables or from the simulator’s own labels, such as which couriers stole orders. Because the world is simulated, these labels are exact and need no anonymization ( Gadotti et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 每项任务有四个部分(附录G. 即时声明,作为一个利益攸关方,这个问题将得到解决。 瞄准镜设定了2024年最后一个月的能见度. 期望列出了分级员需要的文档,每个文件都有其动作、密钥和分级模式。 答案密钥在任何运行前被冻结,来自SQL在潜在表格上或模拟器自己的标签,例如信使盗取订单。 由于世界被模拟,这些标签是准确的,不需要匿名(Gadotti等,2024.).

blocks.en: Prompts cover a range of writing styles and levels of detail. Some reference the grading criteria or the exact output expected, while others are more subtle. This reflects how real users pose data questions: loosely, as high-level business questions, and in no set style or template ( Kandel et al., 2012 ) . It also tests the skill of exploring data organization, since a less detailed prompt leaves the agent to discover which tables and conventions the question depends on. Several scenarios come in variants that differ only in such detail, and Appendix I compares them.
blocks.zh: 提示涵盖一系列的写作风格和详细程度. 有些人提到叙级标准或预期的准确产出,而另一些则比较微妙。 这反映了真实用户如何提出数据问题:松散地,作为高层次的业务问题,没有设定样式或模板(Kandel等,2012年). 它还检验了探索数据组织的技能,因为较不详细的提示让代理人发现问题所依赖的表格和公约。 几种情况是不同的变体,只有如此详细,附录一加以比较。

blocks.en:
Unlike most data science and analytics benchmarks, Argo-Bench does not ask agents to return a query. Agents file actions to a mission-control interface through a Python library in their sandbox (Appendix E ). This design has four advantages. First, it permits advanced data science tasks which require machine learning, operations research, and mathematical optimization libraries to complete. Second, it supports end-to-end workflows. Emitting the correct SQL is not enough in practice, as real tasks require taking actions, e.g., rebalancing courier incentives across zones and hours, banning a set of users who are likely committing fraud, or holding the payouts of a suspicious merchant.
Third, filings are explicit declarations of intent. When benchmarks compare SQL results ( Li et al., 2023 ; Lei et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) , it is hard to determine whether a close number is the agent’s answer or an intermediate result, whereas a filing states the value, interval, or reason the agent commits to, which also makes partial credit well defined. Fourth, grading is objective, unlike the LLM-as-a-judge evaluation ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) used in many related works.
blocks.zh:
与大多数数据科学和分析基准不同,Argo-Bench不要求代理商返回查询. Agents通过他们的沙盒(Appendix E.)中的Python库向任务控制接口文件动作. 这个设计有四个优点. 首先,它允许先进的数据科学任务,这些任务需要机器学习,操作研究和数学优化库完成. 第二,它支持端到端的工作流程. 承认正确的SQL在实践中是不够的,因为实际任务需要采取行动,例如重新平衡跨地区和跨小时的快递奖励措施,禁止可能进行欺诈的用户,或扣押可疑商人的付款。
第三,申报是明确的意向声明。 当基准比较SQL结果(Li等,2023;Lei等,2025;Chen等,2024)时,很难确定接近数字是代理人的答案还是中间结果,而备案则说明代理人承诺的价值、间隔或理由,这也使部分信用得到很好的界定。 第四,分级是客观的,与许多相关作品中使用的LLM-as-a-judge评价(郑等,2023)不同.

blocks.en: Of the 210 tasks, 178 act on accounts, file a forecast, allocate a budget, or publish a dashboard data source, and 99 see only up to a cutoff month, as an analyst would at that date, so forecasts are graded on months the agent has not seen (Figure 3 ). Prompts average 159 words, 51 tasks require more than one filing, and the reference solution in Figure 1 joins six tables across three EBS modules to recover the minimum-pay rule and fit an interval. In size, Argo-Bench matches long-horizon agent benchmarks such as TheAgentCompany (175 tasks) ( Xu et al., 2025a ) , τ \tau -bench (165) ( Yao et al., 2025 ) , KramaBench (104) ( Lai et al., 2026 ) , and ELT-Bench (100) ( Jin et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 在210项任务中,178项在账户上采取行动,提交预测,分配预算,或发布一个仪表板数据源,99项只看到一个截止月,因为分析员届时会看到,因此预测按代理商未见到的月份进行分级(图3). 提示平均159个字,51个任务需要不止一个备案,图1中的参考解决方案将六个表格合并到三个EBS模块中,以收回最低工资规则并适应间隔. 从规模上看,Argo-Bench与长视剂基准相匹配,如The AgentCompany(175个任务)(徐等,2025a),\tau-bench (165个任务)(姚等,2025年),Krama Bench (104个任务)(Lai等,2026年)和ELT-Bench (100个任务)(Jin等,2025年).

blocks.en: Figure 3: Tasks in each business area vary by expected final action and the snapshot of data given. (a) Tasks per business area, grouped by action taken. Multi-part tasks are counted by their first filing. (b) The last month of 2024 visible to the agent in the 99 tasks with a partial view. Partial views are used mostly in forecasting tasks, which are graded against the months after the cutoff.
blocks.zh: 图3:每个业务领域的任务因预期的最后行动和给出的数据简介而异。 (a) 按所采取行动分类的每个业务领域的任务。 多段任务通过首次备案计算. (b) 2024年最后一个月,在99个任务中被代理人看到,并带有部分视图。 部分视图主要用于预测任务,这些任务按照截断后的月份进行分级.

blocks.en: Each expectation is scored from 0 to 100 (a forecast from − 200 -200 ) by one of nine grading modes (Appendix G ). Forecasts are scored by their weighted interval score ( Bracher et al., 2021 ) on a scale set by a reference forecast fixed before the outcome, so that filing one’s true median and interval is the best strategy, ban lists by the cost they save relative to banning nobody or everybody ( Elkan, 2001 ) , budget allocations by the share of the attainable savings that the simulator realizes, and data sources and reported figures by their values. A task’s score is the mean of its expectations’ scores, weighted as the task specifies. A run that files nothing where the key expects action scores zero on every expectation ( − 200 -200 on a forecast, the lowest a forecast can score).
blocks.zh: 每个期望从0到100(预测从-200到-200)按9个分级模式之一(附录G.)得到分数。 预测按其加权间隔得分(Bracher等人,2021年)按结果前设定的参考预测设定的尺度进行,因此,提交个人真实的中位数和间隔是最佳策略,禁止按他们相对于禁止任何人或任何人所节省的费用列出清单(Elkan,2001年),预算分配按模拟器实现的可实现节约的份额分配,数据来源和按其价值报告数字。 任务得分是其预期得分的平均值,按任务规定加权。 一个不记录关键预期动作对每个预期都为零的运行(在预测中为-200-200,预测中得分最低的).

blocks.en: We release the warehouse of one world on Hugging Face and keep a second, generated from a private seed, for official grading. We ran our experiments on BigQuery (941 GB uncompressed), and the released warehouse is a set of 1,219 Parquet files (76.5 GB), with a dataset card giving setup instructions for BigQuery, DuckDB, Snowflake, Trino, Delta Lake, and Iceberg. The two seeds share the simulator and its calibration, but every ID, customer, restaurant, and courier differs. 4 4 4 Because the economy depends on the seed, volumes also differ slightly. The public warehouse has 7.54 billion rows compared to the 7.49 billion in the private world described in this paper. Table 1 compares Argo-Bench with prior benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们释放一个世界的仓库 在哈吉脸 并保留第二个, 由私人种子产生, 为官方分级。 我们运行了BigQuery(941 GB uncompressed)的实验,发布的仓库是一组有1,219个Parquet文件(76.5 GB),有数据集卡为BigQuery,DuckDB,Snowflake,Trino,Delta Lake,和Iceberg提供设置指令. 两个种子共享模拟器及其校正,但每个ID,客户,餐厅和快递都不同. 页:1 4 由于经济依赖于种子,体积也略有不同. 与本文所描述的私人世界74.9亿相比,公共仓库有75.4亿行. 表1比较了Argo-Bench与以前的基准。

Tables and rows are per database. Entries marked n/r are not reported by the benchmark. A coherent system is a single enterprise application whose tables must reconcile. Actions are graded when the benchmark scores what the agent changes or files rather than an answer it returns.

blocks.en: 3 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3. 评价

blocks.en: We run all experiments on Inspect AI 0.3.263 ( UK AI Security Institute, 2024 ) , an open-source evaluation framework, on Google Kubernetes Engine. Each agent works in its own gVisor ( Young et al., 2019 ) sandbox with 25 preinstalled Python libraries, an empty file system, and no outbound internet access, and files to its own mission-control instance through a Python library ( mission_control.py ) that emulates a company’s internal tooling. A run ends after 500 model turns, to stop models that loop without progress, and Appendix F lists the other limits. We evaluate models available in September 2026 across price ranges (Table 2 ), calling open-weight models through Fireworks serverless endpoints and the others through their developers’ APIs, with default sampling settings for every model.
blocks.zh: 在Google Kubernetes引擎上的开源评价框架, 每个代理都在自己的gVisor(Young等人,2019年)沙盒中工作,拥有25个预先安装的Python库,一个空文件系统,没有外出互联网访问,并且通过一个Python库(mission_control.py)向自己的任务控制实例提供文件,该库模仿公司的内部工具. 运行结束于500个模型转后,以阻止那些没有进展而循环的模型,附录F列出了其他限制. 我们通过Fireworks的无服务器端点来评估2026年9月可用的模型(表2),将开放重量模型称为开放重量模型,其他的则通过开发商的API,每个模型都有默认的采样设置.

Steps (model calls) and cost (API spend, excluding BigQuery) are per-task averages. Best results are in bold .

blocks.en: 3.1 Results
blocks.zh: 3.1 结果

blocks.en: Claude Opus 5.5 leads overall and in three of the five domains (Table 2 ), GPT-6 Astra leads in forecasting, and Claude Sonnet 5.5 leads in compliance. More reasoning effort helps the GPT-6 and Claude models at every step, with diminishing returns for Opus, which gains 17.0 points from low to medium effort, 5.9 from medium to high, and 4.0 from high to extra-high, while Claude Sonnet 5.5 gains 14.9 and 11.5 over the last two steps. Gemini 3.8 Flash gains 8.6 points from low to medium [4.9, 16.3] and Qwen 3.8 Max gains 5.2, and neither gains detectably afterward. Muse Spark 1.3 changes by less than 2 points past medium, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash moves only at extra-high (Appendix I ). Gemini 3.8 Flash and Muse Spark 1.3 also average 197 and 250 model calls per task, compared to 82 for Opus, without scoring higher, and 57% of Muse’s warehouse spend goes to tasks on which it scores below 5 out of 100 (Appendix K ).
blocks.zh: Claude Opus 5.5在总体上领先,在五个域中的三个域(表2),GPT-6 Astra在预测上领先,克洛德·索内 5.5在遵守上领先. 更多的推理努力帮助了GPT-6和克洛德模型的每个步骤,Opus的回报率不断下降,从低到中的努力获得17.0分,从中到高从5.9分,从高到高从4.0分,而克洛德·索内5.5则在过去两个步骤中获得了14.9分和11.5分. 双子座 3.8 Flash从中低得8.6分[4.9,16.3]和Quen 3.8 Max得到5.2分,后两者均无法探测得到. Muse Spark 1.3 通过介质小于2分的改变,和 Depseek V4.1 Flash只在外高时移动(附录一. 双子座 3.8 Flash 和 Muse Spark 1. 3 平均每个任务都有197个和 250个型号呼叫, 而Opus的82个型号没有得分高, Muse的仓库开支有57%用于它得分低于5分/100的任务(附录 K )。

blocks.en: Many tasks are prompt variants of one scenario, so we resample the 146 base scenarios when bootstrapping. The resulting 95% confidence intervals are about ± \pm 2 to 8 points on the score and up to ± \pm 8 points on the solved rate. Paired by task, Opus leads each of the next three models (GPT-6 Astra, Claude Sonnet 5.5, and GPT-6.1 Sol) by 7.7 to 10.0 points, and those three are not separated from one another. GPT-6.1 Sol leads its predecessor GPT-6 Sol by 12.8 points [6.8, 19.1], GPT-6 Sol leads Kimi K3 by 8.4 [0.5, 15.4], and the intervals of the next five overlap (Appendix I ).
blocks.zh: 许多任务都是一种情景的即时变体,所以我们重现了被拖住的146个基本情景。 由此产生的95%的置信间隔在分数上大约为±\pm 2到8分,在解出分数上最高为±\pm 8分. Paired 根据任务,奥普斯带领后三个型号(GPT-6 Astra,克洛德·索内特 5.5,和GPT-6.1 Sol)分别以7.7分到10.0分,而这三个型号并不相分离. GPT-6.1 Sol以12.8分领先其前身GPT-6 Sol [6.8, 19.1],GPT-6 Sol以8.4分领先Kimi K3 [0.5, 15.4],以及后五相重叠的间隔(附录一.

blocks.en: 3.2 Findings
blocks.zh: 3.2 调查结果

blocks.en: Many failing runs use sound methods but read the wrong record, optimize the wrong objective, or measure the wrong quantity. Passing runs check definitions against a second source (Appendix I ).
blocks.zh: 许多失败运行使用声音方法,但读取错误的记录,优化错误的目标,或测量错误的数量. 传出会对照第二个来源检查定义(附录一.

blocks.en: A marketing dashboard asks whether each discount offer paid off against the same push notification with the coupon left out for every thousand customers it was sent to, for members and non-members. Only Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, and GPT-6.1 Sol at extra-high effort publish the right table. What separates them is who counted as a member at the moment of targeting. A member whose card is declined keeps the benefits for seven days of grace and then loses them, but the contract stays on the books until it is canceled weeks later. Twenty-four of the failing runs take membership from the contract’s dates, and seven of them get every other figure right to within a few dollars. The three passing runs replay the billing history instead and check the result against the orders on which a member benefit was actually applied. Opus reads the seven-day grace off those orders, and GPT-6.1 Sol starts from the contract dates, finds 1,057 orders that its rule calls members’ and that received no benefit, and starts over.
blocks.zh: 一个营销仪表板询问,每一份折扣报价是否与每千名客户、会员和非会员收到的优惠券的同样推价通知相抵。 只有克洛德·奥普斯·5.5、GPT-6 Astra和GPT-6.1 Sol at extra-high cripment 发布正确的表格. 把他们分开的,是在锁定目标时算作成员。 被拒卡的会员将优惠保留了7天,然后失去优惠,但合同留在帐上,直到几周后取消。 24个失败者从合同日期开始获得会员资格,其中7个在几美元之内获得其他数字。 三个传球则重播计费历史,对照实际适用会员福利的订单检查结果. Opus将七天的恩典从这些命令读出, GPT-6.1 Sol从合同日期开始,发现1,057个命令,其规则要求成员不受益,然后重新开始。

blocks.en: One family of tasks asks where to cut $9.6 million from the annual budget for courier bonuses (quests). At extra-high effort and without hints, GPT-6 Astra finds the zones and hours where quests were randomly withheld, estimates supply responses with fixed effects and partial pooling, and cuts where quests buy the fewest courier-hours. The platform pays for quests to avoid surge pay; however, under the simulator’s response model, the plan loses $86,281 where a uniform cut would save $0.40 million, and it scores 0. From the same prompt, Claude Opus 5.5 at extra-high effort finds that quests substitute for surge pay, cuts where they save the least surge per bonus dollar, and saves $3.09 million of an attainable $3.12 million (score 99). Stating what quests are for and that a holdout exists raises the mean over all settings from 18.5 to 61.7.
blocks.zh: 一个任务家庭要求从年度预算中从哪里削减960万美元,用于运送人奖金(遗赠)。 GPT-6 Astra在无提示的情况下,在超高的努力中发现了随机拒绝寻找的区域和时数,估计了提供具有固定效果和部分集合的响应,并削减了寻找者购买信使时数最少的地方. 该平台为避免高额薪酬的追求付费;然而,在模拟器的反应模式下,计划损失了86 281美元,其中统一削减将节省40万美元,并得分 0. 克劳德·奥普斯(Claude Opus)5.5从同一提示中发现,追求替代了高涨工资,削减了他们节省的每个奖金最少的涨幅,并节省了可实现的312万美元(99分)中的309万美元。 标出追求的目的和存在阻力使所有环境的平均值从18.5提高到61.7。

blocks.en: Many failures come from measuring a quantity other than the one the prompt asks for. Of the 47 completed runs of a task that sizes the courier location service, 46 miss all 12 monthly counts despite a 1% tolerance because the warehouse keeps only hourly idle check-ins while the app sends them every half hour. GPT-6 Astra notices the gap, writes that its count does not establish how many reports the app sent, and files it anyway. Only Claude Sonnet 5.5 at extra-high effort adds the missing half-hourly check-ins back. Across the dashboard tasks, 66.9% of the data sources that pass their structural contract score zero on their values.
blocks.zh: 许多失败都来自于对一个数量进行测量,而不是及时要求的数量。 在完成的47次任务中,有46次错过了所有12个月的点数,尽管有1%的容受度,因为仓库只保留每小时的闲置入帐,而应用程序每半小时发送一次。 GPT-6 Astra注意到这个缺口, 写道, 只有Claude Sonnet5.5在超高强度工作 加上了半个小时的检查 在仪表板任务中,66.9%通过结构合同的数据源的数值为零。

blocks.en: Across 4,553 forecast series from 3,346 runs on 72 tasks, nominal 80% intervals contain the realized value only 44.8% of the time. Apart from its floor, the grade is proper, so this overconfidence costs models points in expectation, although a per-series skill score clipped at zero would have rewarded a narrower interval in 72% of series (Appendix I ). Grades also depend on the reference, which sets each series’ scale. Against the tighter reference of their harder variant, the June base-pay forecasts fall from a mean grade of 84.7 to 6.0, although their median absolute error is only 1.57%. Appendix I reports coverage and absolute error.
blocks.zh: 在4,553个预测系列中,有3,346个系列在72个任务上运行,名义上80%的间隔只包含44.8%的实现值。 除了其下层,等级是适当的,因此这种过度自信成本模型在预期中得分,尽管每系列技能分数被剪去为0,将会在72%的系列中奖励更窄的间隔(附录一). 分级还取决于参照标准,该参照标准规定了每个系列的分级。 与较硬的变式相比,6月的基薪预测从84.7%降至6.0,尽管其中间绝对误差仅为1.57%。 附录一报告了覆盖面和绝对错误。

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en: Text-to-SQL benchmarks have moved from databases with a handful of tables each ( Yu et al., 2018 ; Li et al., 2023 ) to enterprise-scale schemas ( Lei et al., 2025 ) and private data warehouses ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , and data science benchmarks extend evaluation to multi-step analysis, data lakes, and data pipelines ( Jing et al., 2025 ; Egg et al., 2025 ; Lai et al., 2026 ; Lei et al., 2026 ; Jin et al., 2025 ) . These benchmarks compare an agent’s output to a gold answer, which audits have found to be frequently wrong ( Wretblad et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2026 ) , or to expert conclusions, often scored by an LLM judge ( Gu et al., 2024 ; Sahu et al., 2025 ) . Argo-Bench instead grades the actions that an agent files against the simulator’s latent state.
blocks.zh: 文本至SQL基准从各有少量表格的数据库(Yu等人,2018年;Li等人,2023年)转移到企业规模计划(Lei等人,2025年)和私人数据仓库(Chen等人,2024年),数据科学基准将评价扩展到多步骤分析、数据湖和数据管道(Jing等人,2025年;Egg等人,2025年;Lai等人,2026年;Lei等人,2026年;Jin等人,2025年)。 这些基准将代理人的产出与黄金答案相提并论,审计发现黄金答案往往是错误的(Wretblad等,2024;Jin等,2026;或专家结论,通常由LLM法官评出(Gu等,2024;Sahu等,2025)。 Argo-Bench 将代理记录的动作与模拟器的潜伏状态进行对比。

blocks.en: Simulated environments are the standard way to evaluate agents that act. AppWorld ( Trivedi et al., 2024 ) and τ \tau -bench ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Barres et al., 2025 ) check the final state of the environment’s database. TheAgentCompany ( Xu et al., 2025a ) scores checkpoints in a simulated software company, and CRMArena-Pro ( Huang et al., 2026 ) shapes LLM-generated CRM records with latent variables. Vending-Bench and Business Arena score the net worth of a business that the agent runs ( Backlund & Petersson, 2025 ; Pan et al., 2026 ) . In these benchmarks, the state that determines success is either observable to the agent or changed by the agent inside a stylized game. In Argo-Bench, it is withheld and must be reconstructed from an enterprise warehouse. Simulators calibrated to public statistics have likewise supplied ground truth that real data lacks for patient records ( Walonoski et al., 2018 ) and money laundering ( Altman et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 模拟环境是评价行事代理人的标准方法. AppWorld(Trivedi等人,2024年)和\tau-bench(姚等人,2025年;Barres等人,2025年)检查环境数据库的最终状态。 The AgentCompany(Xu等,2025年a)在模拟软件公司评分检查站,而CRMArena-Pro(Huang等,2026年)则以潜在变量塑造LLM生成的CRM记录. Vending-Bench and Business Arena)获得代理商所经营业务的净值(Backlund & Petersson, 2025; Pan等, 2026.). 在这些基准中,决定成功与否的状态要么可以观察到代理商,要么被代理商在打字游戏中改变. 在Argo-Bench,它被扣留,必须从企业仓库重建。 与公共统计数据相匹配的模拟器同样为患者记录(Walonoski等人,2018年)和洗钱(Altman等人,2023年)提供了缺乏真实数据的事实。

blocks.en: AvalancheBench ( Kłeczek et al., 2026 ) uses an LLM judge to score how much of a small latent e-commerce world an agent’s report recovers. The Era by Eon benchmark ( Gruenbaum et al., 2026 ) serves a generated company through a fleet of 66 simulated products, calibrated to operational and published statistics, and plants the records that answer each of its read-only questions, together with near misses. Two unrelated benchmarks named ERPBench evaluate decisions in a simulated manufacturer ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) and computer-use tasks in a live ERP system ( Bhagtani et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, the latent state of Argo-Bench is produced by the simulation itself rather than being planted. Its evidence is spread across an enterprise warehouse of 7.49 billion rows, and agents are graded on the consequences of the actions they file rather than on the answers they give.
blocks.zh: Avalanche Bench(Klaeczek等,2026年)用LLM评分来评分一个代理商的报告恢复了多少小的潜在电子商务世界。 " Era by Eon"基准(Gruenbaum et al., 2026)通过66个模拟产品组成的车队为一家生成的公司服务,这些模拟产品被校准为可操作和已公布的统计数据,并植入了回答每个只读问题的记录,以及近乎缺失的记录. 名为ERP Bench的两个无关基准对模拟制造商(Zhang等,2026年)的决定和实时ERP系统中的计算机使用任务进行评估(Bhagtani等,2026年)。 相比之下,阿尔戈-奔驰的潜在状态是由模拟本身产生的,而不是被植入. 其证据被分散在一个749亿行的企业仓库中,代理商被分级处理他们所提交行动的后果,而不是他们给出的答案.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations & Future Work
blocks.zh: 5 限制和未来工作

blocks.en: The dataset still differs from the most complex ERP deployments in four ways. First, the dataset covers a single city, so it has no foreign currency and none of its representations as transaction, local, and reporting currency. Second, many complex warehouses combine several businesses, such as food delivery and grocery delivery, with shared accounts, such as driver payables and customer credits, mixing them in a single balance. Third, only one year is simulated. A longer history, such as 2017 to 2026, would add the market shocks of 2020 to 2022 to operations and forecasts. Fourth, only one ERP format is supported, and a natural extension would be to add SAP S/4HANA.
blocks.zh: 数据集在四个方面仍然不同于最复杂的企业资源规划部署。 首先,数据集涵盖一个城市,因此它没有外币,也没有作为交易货币、当地货币和报告货币的表述。 第二,许多复杂的仓库将食品交付和杂货交付等若干业务与司机应付款和客户信贷等共享账户结合起来,将它们混为一谈。 第三,只模拟一年。 较长的历史,如2017年至2026年,将会将2020年的市场冲击加到2022年的运营和预测. 第四,只支持一种机构资源规划格式,自然会增加SAP S/4HANA。

blocks.en: The simulator validates 23 distinct metrics, and we keep behaviors that public figures do not constrain out of scope for tasks. The in-world membership program in particular rests on weakly grounded assumptions. More generally, a simulator encodes the assumptions of its authors, and a generator that shares the simplifying assumptions of the systems under evaluation can make tasks easier than their real counterparts ( Leis et al., 2015 ) . Calibration to aggregate targets also does not guarantee realistic tails ( Chen et al., 2019 ) . Argo-Bench therefore compares data agents and does not estimate their performance on a real company’s warehouse.
blocks.zh: 模拟器验证了23个截然不同的度量衡,我们保留了公众人物不会被限制在任务范围之外的行为. 世界上的成员方案尤其依赖于基础薄弱的假设。 更一般地说,一个模拟器编码其作者的假设,一个共享被评价系统的简化假设的生成器可以使任务比其真正的对应者容易(Leis等人,2015年). 对总量目标的校正也不保证有现实的尾巴(Chen等,2019. Argo-Bench因此比较了数据代理商,没有估计他们在一家真正的公司仓库的性能.

blocks.en: Each setting of the model and effort has one run per task, and all tasks share one simulated world, so our confidence intervals reflect the choice of tasks rather than run-to-run variation. Scores on some tasks are also sensitive to prompt wording, so Appendix I reports every hinted and unhinted pair, including one prompt we judged to be underspecified. Plan tasks are graded under the simulator’s frozen response model, and Appendix J lists open issues by task.
blocks.zh: 每一个模型和努力的设置每个任务都有一次运行,所有的任务都共享一个模拟的世界,因此我们的信心间隔反映了任务的选择,而不是运行到运行的变化. 某些任务的分数对即时措辞也很敏感,因此附录一报告了每一个提示和未提示的对子,包括一个被我们判断为不够精确的对子. 计划任务在模拟器的冷冻反应模式下进行分级,附录J按任务列出未决问题.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced Argo-Bench, which evaluates data agents on a simulated food delivery platform exported to an Oracle E-Business Suite warehouse of 235 tables and 7.49 billion rows. Because the simulator’s latent state is withheld from the warehouse, Argo-Bench grades the facts agents reconstruct and the actions they file, with every answer key computed from ground truth. The strongest of 14 models solves 34.8% of tasks and averages 59.5 points, and its most instructive failures are careful analyses of the wrong quantity, toward the wrong objective, or read from the wrong record. We release the public seed’s warehouse, tasks, reference solutions, and harness, and hope that Argo-Bench helps measure progress toward data agents that can understand, navigate, and act within real enterprise data environments.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Argo-Bench,它评价一个模拟食品交付平台上的数据代理,该平台出口到一个235个桌子和74.9亿行的Oracle E-Business套房仓库。 因为模拟器的潜伏状态被从仓库中扣下,阿尔戈-本奇将事实代理人重建以及他们提交的动作分级,每个答案都从地面的真相计算出来. 14个模型中最强者解决了34.8%的任务,平均59.5分,其最有启发性的失败是仔细分析错误的数量,朝着错误的目标,或者从错误的记录中读取. 我们释放了公共种子的仓库、任务、参考解决方案和驾驭手段,并希望阿尔戈-本奇帮助衡量数据代理商在真正企业数据环境中能够理解、导航和采取行动的进展。

blocks.en: AI use statement
blocks.zh: AI 语句

blocks.en: Large language models were used in three ways. First, as coding assistants for the simulator, graders, reference solutions, and figure and table code. Second, in the simulator’s data work: tuning its parameters, cleaning donor datasets, and reconciling restaurant records across sources (Section 2.1 ). No record in the simulated world is generated by a language model, and every value in the warehouse comes from the simulator, except the fictional names of the storefronts renamed in the released warehouse, which a language model drafted (see the ethics statement). Third, in writing: some task prompts were drafted by a language model and then curated and rewritten by the authors, and language models edited the text of the paper and checked its citations. The authors checked every claim, number, and citation, and take full responsibility for the content of the paper.
blocks.zh: 使用大语言模型有三种方式。 首先,作为模拟器的编码助理,分级器,参考解决方案,以及图和表代码. 第二,模拟器的数据工作:调整其参数、清理捐助者数据集并核对各种来源的餐厅记录(第2.1节)。 模拟世界中没有任何记录是由语言模型生成的,而仓库中每个值都出自模拟器,除了在已放行的仓库中被更名的存储站前的虚构名称外,这些存储站前被一个语言模型所起草(参见道德说明). 第三,书面:一些任务提示由语言模型起草,然后由作者整理并重写,语言模型编辑了论文的正文并检查其引用. 提交人检查了每一项申诉、编号和引文,并对文件的内容承担了全部责任。

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: Argo-Bench contains no data about real people. Consumer and courier names are drawn from public name-frequency tables and assigned to simulated people, and every order, shift, and payment is simulated. Restaurants are real New York City businesses. Their names and addresses come from Overture Maps places matched to the city’s inspection records, with some names updated to the business’s current listing, and some storefronts the simulator opens during the year, such as relaunches and virtual brands, take the name of a real business that was not trading at the time. All behavior attributed to them in the world, including the fraud patterns of Section 2.1 , is simulated. The simulator draws which storefronts play a fraud role, not from any record of a business’s conduct, so a label says nothing about the real business. Even so, in the released warehouse every storefront that plays a fraud role in any scenario carries a fictional name instead of its real one, and fields derived from the name, such as its contact email, follow the new name. The released questions and agent transcripts use the same fictional names. A language model drafted the fictional names to read like real New York restaurant names, so that a renamed storefront does not stand out and point to the answers, and each was checked against the city’s inspection records and Overture Maps so that none is the name of a real restaurant. Addresses are unchanged, since the simulated geography depends on them. The donor datasets are used under their licenses. Those released for research or non-commercial use, such as the Yelp Open Dataset and the Grubhub MDRP instances, serve only as shape donors, and none of their records enters the world or the warehouse (Appendix A ). The fraud tasks reward detecting common schemes, not carrying them out. During development, one model escaped an insufficiently isolated sandbox and read the grader code (Appendix D ). The final runs use isolated sandboxes without internet access, and we report the incident so that others building agent benchmarks can guard against it.
blocks.zh: Argo-Bench没有关于真人的数据. 消费者和信使的名字取自公共名称频率表,并被分配给模拟人员,每个订单,班次和付款都被模拟. 餐馆是纽约市真正的企业. 他们的名字和地址来自Overture Maps与该市的检查记录相匹配的地方,有些名字更新到企业目前的上市记录,有些商店封面的模拟器在当年打开,如重启和虚拟品牌,取一个当时没有交易的真正企业的名字. 世界上所有归于他们的行为,包括第2.1节的欺诈模式都是被模拟的. 模拟器抽取了哪个店面起着欺诈作用,而不是从企业行为的任何记录中抽取,因此标签对真正的企业没有任何说明。 即便如此,在已放行的仓库中,在任何情景中扮演欺诈角色的每一个商店前端都带有虚构的名称而不是其真实的名称,从名称中衍生出来的字段,比如其联系电子邮件,都跟随新名称. 发布的问题和特工笔录使用相同的虚构名称. 一个语言模型起草了虚构的名字来读取真实的纽约餐厅名称,这样一个被重新命名的店面就不会突出并指向答案,每个店面都根据城市的检查记录和Overture Maps来检查,这样就没有一个真正餐厅的名称了. 地址没有变化,因为模拟地理依赖于它们. 捐助数据集是根据其许可证使用的。 发行用于研究或非商业用途的,如"Yelp Open Datas集"和"Grubhub MDRP"等例,仅作为形状捐赠者,其记录都没有进入世界或仓库(附录A. 欺诈任务奖励发现共同计划,而不是执行这些计划。 在开发过程中,有一个模型从一个不够孤立的沙盒中逃出并读取了分级码(Appendix D. 最终运行使用没有互联网连接的孤立沙盒,我们报告事件,以便其他人建立代理基准来防范.

blocks.en: Reproducibility statement
blocks.zh: 可复制说明

blocks.en: Two artifacts are released. The warehouse of one seed is released on Hugging Face under CC BY 4.0 at https://huggingface.co/datasets/textql/Argo-Bench . The code that reproduces the paper’s runs is released under the Apache License 2.0 at https://github.com/TextQLLabs/Argo-Bench . It contains the 210 questions, the reference agent on Inspect AI 0.3.263, its warehouse and Python tool servers, the mission-control console through which the agent files, the three sandboxes in which run_python executes (a macOS Seatbelt profile, a Docker image with pinned libraries, and the network-less gVisor pod used for the paper’s runs), loaders for DuckDB and BigQuery, and the model and reasoning-effort configuration for every rung reported. The system prompt and tools are given in Appendices E and F , and Appendix L shows three reference solutions in full.

blocks.en: The simulator and the graders are not released to prevent direct answer memorization. A run made with the released code exports a submission file recording every filing, the model and its settings, token usage, and how each run ended, which we score on a best-effort basis. The paper’s runs queried a second world generated by the same simulator from a different seed (Section 2.3 ). The 15 questions that name specific couriers, storefronts, or promotion codes draw them from the public world by the same selection rule. Re-running the released code therefore reproduces the paper’s procedure on a sibling world rather than its exact numbers. Proprietary models were accessed through their providers’ APIs, and all other models through Fireworks serverless endpoints with default settings in September 2026. Results from proprietary APIs may drift as providers update their models.

blocks.en: In an early round of runs, the Python sandbox did not isolate the agent from the evaluation host. In three runs of fraud-04, Gemini 3.8 Flash changed its root directory, located the grader for the task, and filed the answer it read there, scoring 0.99 ( Skalse et al., 2022 ) . We searched the traces of every run in that round for the same behavior and found it in no other model. The round was discarded. Every run reported in this paper executes Python in a network-less gVisor pod under Inspect’s Kubernetes sandbox provider on GKE, and each run’s BigQuery service account can read only the dataset scoped to its task. The relevant agent traces are included in the GitHub release.

blocks.en: Each sandbox runs under gVisor ( Young et al., 2019 ) with 4 GiB of memory (12 GiB for the few runs repeated after the sandbox ran out of memory), one CPU, and 10 GiB of ephemeral disk. Each run is limited to 500 model turns and 240 minutes. A run that reaches a limit, exhausts the model’s context window, or crashes its sandbox is graded on whatever it submitted before stopping. Of the 9,869 graded runs, 56 (0.6%) reached the turn limit, 43 of them from Muse Spark 1.3 and 13 from Gemini 3.8 Flash, and 65 (0.7%) reached the context window, all from Qwen 3.8 Max.

blocks.en: Appendix G Task definition and grading
blocks.zh: 附录G 任务定义和等级

blocks.en: A task consists of a prompt, a scope, a list of expectations, and an answer key. The prompt is the only text the agent receives besides the system prompt (Appendix E ). The scope sets the last month of 2024 in the warehouse the agent queries. Each expectation names one filing the grader requires, with its action (for instance ban_couriers or file_forecasts ), the keys it is filed against, such as vendor IDs or months, and its grading mode. The answer key is computed once, before any run, and frozen. It comes either from truth queries, which are SQL over the latent tables, or from a local builder, which reads the simulator’s labels directly, for instance which couriers were made to steal orders. Listing 1 gives both definitions with their defaults.

blocks.en: Each expectation scores between 0 and 100, a forecast between − 200 -200 and 100, and the task score is their weighted mean. Mixing binary, graded, and forecast scales in one mean is a choice, so Table 2 also reports the solved rate, which does not depend on how the scales are mixed, and per-domain means, and it floors each model’s forecast tasks at 0 as a block so that a few very wrong forecasts cannot outweigh the rest. Of the 210 tasks, 159 have one scored expectation, 37 have two, and 14 have three. An expectation marked optional is graded and reported but left out of the mean. If a run files nothing while the key expects at least one action, every expectation scores 0, and a forecast expectation − 200 -200 . A filing that carries many items, such as one ban_customers call with 300 accounts, is split into its items before grading, so it scores the same as 300 separate filings. IDs and keys are compared as normalized text: case and surrounding whitespace do not matter, and 6057444.0 is 6057444 . A key filed inside a longer string, such as payout period P17 , also counts, but only on a token boundary, so P17 does not match P170 .

The other 22 cross a regime change, such as the minimum-pay rule, where no change is not a serious benchmark, and their reference is frozen into the answer key as a point r r and a standard deviation s s at the horizon. Most are a figure the prompt attributes to the business and asks the agent to check, computed by the method the prompt states from the data the agent can see. blocks.en: Three choices in Equation 1 shape how a ban is scored. First, a neutral account is left out of both baselines, so leaving it open is never a miss, while banning it still costs a review. If neutral bans were free, a run could ban the whole population and keep the targets it swept up; if they were charged as false positives, finding real fraud outside the task’s scope would be punished. Second, an ID that is in no universe cannot be priced from the key. Charging it only a a would make an invented ID nearly free, so it is charged the median innocent margin as well. Third, in 18 of the 45 cost_set expectations a wrong ban destroys only part of the innocent’s margin, one half or one tenth, which models appeals and reinstatements and makes precision matter less relative to recall. Across the final tasks, 38 expectations use a = $ 2 a=\$2 and ν = 1 2 \nu=\tfrac{1}{2} , three use a = $ 25 a=\$25 and ν = 1 \nu=1 , and four charge no review, so that only losses and margins count. The savings before clipping can be negative, which means the bans destroyed more value than either baseline, and the grader reports that value although the score stops at 0.

blocks.en: A publish_data_sources filing is the table behind a dashboard tile: its columns, and the rows the tile would show. Each task carries a contract that names the columns, their types, and which of them form the key; the contract is also the schema the agent is given. A publication missing a contract column scores 0. Otherwise the filed frame is right when it has exactly the key rows of the answer and every cell matches: numbers within the column’s tolerance, integers exactly, dates to the day, and text after normalization. The score is 100 for a right frame and 0 for any other, since a tile with any wrong row cannot be used. The share of rows that were right is reported, but does not enter the score.
blocks.zh: 公布的_data_source文件是仪表板平板砖后面的表格:它的列,平板砖会显示的行. 每项任务都附有一份合同,其中列出栏目、类型和构成键的栏目;合同也是给予代理人的计划。 缺少合同栏分数的出版物 0,否则备案框架在它有准确的答案的关键行和每个单元格匹配时是正确的:列可容度内的数字,整数,日期和日期,以及正常化后的文本。 得分为:右相框100分,任何其他相框为0分,因为有出错行的瓦片不能被使用. 报告正确行的份额,但不输入分数。

blocks.en: A file_schedules filing is a named table with key columns and rows, such as a reconciliation of receivables to the general ledger. The grader picks the schedule by name, matches rows on the key columns as normalized text, and counts a row correct when every numeric column of the answer is present and within tolerance. Other filed columns are ignored, so a schedule may carry its workings. The score is 100 times the correct rows over the answer’s rows plus, in 13 of the 14 tasks, the filed rows the answer does not contain, so a reconciling item invented to force a tie counts against the schedule. A schedule filed twice under one name keeps the later copy.
blocks.zh: 文件_附表备案是一个有关键栏和行的命名表,如应收款与总分类账的对账. 分级者按名称选择时间表,将密钥列上行相匹配为正态文本,当答案的每个数字列都存在并处于可容忍度内时,则数行正确. 其他已存档的列被忽略,因此一个时间表可能带有其工作功能. 在14个任务中的13个任务中, 存档的行并不包含答案, 因此发明了一个调和项目, 以一个名字提交的两次时间表保留了后一份。

blocks.en: A report_metrics filing reports a value per key, such as a figure for each month, and a remediate_payments filing an amount per account or pay period. A key is correct when its value is within the larger of an absolute tolerance and a relative one. The score is 100 times the correct keys over all keys in the answer, so a wrong or missing key costs the same. In 5 of the 35 expectations, keys the answer does not contain are added to the denominator as well, for questions where reporting an extra key is itself an error.
blocks.zh: 报告_度量衡报告每个键值,如每个月的数字,以及补救_付款报告每个账户或付款期的数额。 关键在于其价值在绝对容忍和相对容忍的更大范围内。 得分是答案中所有键的100倍正确键,所以一个错误或缺失的键成本是一样的. 在35个期望中的5个,答案中并不包含的密钥也被添加到分母中,因为报告额外密钥本身就是一个错误的问题。

blocks.en: For an id_set expectation, the grader takes the filed IDs as a prediction of the answer’s set and scores 100 times their F1. Of the 32 such expectations, 27 grade bans whose key is a list of accounts rather than a priced universe, and the rest grade holds, remediations, pay periods, and a discontinued promotion code. If the answer set is empty, the question has no right target: filing nothing scores 100 and filing anything scores 0. The one binary expectation uses the same comparison but scores 100 only for an F1 of exactly 1, because remediating the right accounts together with a wrong one is still a wrong decision. That expectation is also gated on another in its task: it scores only if every shortfall it remediates was first reported within tolerance. Filing no remediation is correct when nobody was shorted, but a run that reported a wrong shortfall and then filed nothing earns credit only if the shortfalls were reported correctly.
blocks.zh: 对于 id_set 期望, 分级员将存档的ID 当作对答案的预测, 并得分100倍于他们的F1. 在32个此类期望中,27个职等禁止,其关键是账户清单,而不是一个定价的宇宙,其余职等则持有、补救、薪酬期和停发晋升守则。 如果答案集为空, 问题没有正确的目标: 无任何评分, 无任何评分 0. 一个二进制预期使用同样的比较,但只为1分的F1打出100分,因为纠正正确的账目和错误的账目仍然是错误的决定。 这种期望还寄托在另一项任务上:只有在它所弥补的每一次不足都首先在容忍范围内得到报告的情况下,才得分。 在没有人缺钱的情况下,不提出补救要求是不正确的,但跑步报错缺钱,然后,只有正确报错缺钱,才算得上任何信贷。

The loss of a plan is the sum over cells of the amount moved times that marginal. blocks.en: Table 9 gives 95% bootstrap confidence intervals for the overall results of Table 2 , from 10,000 resamples of the 146 task families rather than of the 210 tasks. A family is a base scenario together with its prompt variants, such as the hinted and unhinted versions of a task or the four search widths of the refund-collusion task, so variants of one scenario do not count as independent evidence. Families are named by their task stem, which also merges a few distinct scenarios and so errs toward wider intervals. Clustering widens each side of an interval by at most 1.6 points on the score and 1.9 on the solved rate over resampling tasks. Paired by task, with families resampled, Claude Opus 5.5 leads GPT-6 Astra by 7.7 points [1.4, 13.7], Claude Sonnet 5.5 by 7.7 [2.3, 13.4], and GPT-6.1 Sol by 10.0 [3.6, 16.3], while Astra, Sonnet 5.5, and GPT-6.1 Sol are not separated (Astra leads Sonnet 5.5 by 0.1 [ − - 6.5, 6.6] and GPT-6.1 Sol by 2.3 [ − - 1.2, 6.0], and Sonnet 5.5 leads GPT-6.1 Sol by 2.2 [ − - 4.4, 8.7]). GPT-6.1 Sol leads its predecessor GPT-6 Sol by 12.8 [6.8, 19.1] and Kimi K3 by 21.2 [13.8, 28.5]. Astra leads GPT-6 Sol by 15.1 [9.2, 21.4], Sonnet 5.5 leads GPT-6 Sol by 15.0 [8.9, 21.1], and GPT-6 Sol leads Kimi K3 by 8.4 [0.5, 15.4]. Each setting has one run per task, so the intervals reflect which tasks are in the set and not the variance between runs of the same task.

blocks.en: Table 10 gives every model’s mean score at each reasoning effort it offers, on the tasks it completed at every such level. Effort helps the GPT-6 and Claude models at every step, with diminishing returns only for Opus and GPT-6.1 Sol, and the step from high to extra-high adds 1.9 to 11.5 points for them. Kimi K3 gains 10.1 points from low to high and 5.8 more at extra-high, and GLM 5.3 Flash 4.3 from high to extra-high. Past medium, Gemini 3.8 Flash (18.3, 26.9, 26.2) and Qwen 3.8 Max (21.1, 26.3, 24.4) score lower than at medium, Muse Spark 1.3 (16.7, 20.2, 19.7, 20.7) dips at high and recovers at extra-high, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash scores 21.6 at low, 20.5 at high, and 25.4 at extra-high. Each of these drops is under 2 points and within the confidence intervals of Table 9 , so we do not read them as an effect of effort. Two mechanisms are consistent with them. All 65 runs that exhausted the context window are from Qwen 3.8 Max (Appendix F ), whose window is shorter than the other models’, and longer reasoning at higher effort fills it sooner. For the other models, we suspect that runs with many tool calls, each returning data, bury the task’s objective in a long context, and 43 of the 56 runs that reached the turn limit are from Muse Spark 1.3.

blocks.en: I.3 Wrong record
blocks.zh: I.3 记录错误

blocks.en: The task behind the marketing dashboard of Section 3.2 covers 11 campaigns run in April and May 2024. Each campaign is a push notification sent in a few versions, one carrying each of the campaign’s discount offers and one with no coupon attached, the reminder. Every notification sent is one customer-window, a customer and the response period that follows it. For each offer, and separately for members and non-members, the dashboard reports how many windows the offer was sent to, how many the reminder was sent to, the booked order contribution per 1,000 windows of each, and the difference between the two. Whether a customer counts as a member is decided at the moment the message was sent, trials and comped memberships included, and the prompt says that effective starts are inclusive and ends exclusive. That gives 62 rows. Table 11 sorts the 47 settings by what they published.
